methodology.purpose: deterministic impact investigation; not a product behavior change
methodology.typedSemanticCorpus: md raw/lines; TypeScript/JavaScript literal chunks; JSON string values excluding keys
methodology.rawCorpus: all tracked UTF-8 text blobs; binary and unknown invalid-UTF8 blobs are explicitly excluded
methodology.estimator: old plus six range/length candidates and old-range code-point control

selfTest.note: independent literal expectations plus exact-base transpiled baseline

limitations: Dynamic runtime strings are not evaluated.
Template expressions and regex literals are excluded; only literal template chunks are extracted.
JSX text is not treated as a string literal.
Parse failures are fatal for the relevant corpus file.
